description: Source file implementing SysLogOutput class for performance metrics logging, including URL load metrics, system info collection, and telemetry integration within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: SysLogOuput
classes.description: Implements IBrowserMetricsLogger to log performance metrics and telemetry data related to URL loading and system state.

classes.name: URLLoadedMetrics
classes.description: Stores metrics related to URL load, including system info, CPU load, memory, and load timing.

classes.name: MetricsAsJson
classes.description: JSON container for serializing performance metrics for telemetry.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Initializes telemetry, references plugin service, and retrieves process memory info.

methods.name: Disable
methods.description: Releases references to plugin service and memory interfaces.

methods.name: Activated
methods.description: Records start time for idle measurement.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Logs deactivation reason and sends telemetry message.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Logs metrics after URL load completes, including success/failure.

methods.name: URLChange
methods.description: Updates metrics on URL change, capturing system info and process memory.

methods.name: OutputLoadFinishedMetrics
methods.description: Serializes metrics to JSON and sends telemetry.
